verdict.rationale: Greptile documents some bulk actions within a single PR. A 'Fix All' button sends every review issue to a coding agent at once, `/check-pr` fixes all review comments on a PR, and `greptile review --agent` outputs every catch with suggested fixes for an agent to apply. The scope is limited to one PR's comments, with no evidence of bulk operations across many PRs, repositories or other items. Missing for 10: bulk actions across multiple PRs/repos (e.g., batch re-review, batch resolve, bulk settings changes), a bulk API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Fix All / check-pr flows.
